answers.rationale: The requirement specifies a test cabinet with secondary contacts and control relays, which aligns with the features of the CROWN-ARMV product as it is a metal-clad MV switchgear with customizable options for control and testing.
The requirement lists accessories and spare parts for switchgear, which are covered under the CROWN-ACC product, as it includes catalog accessories for MV switchgear.
The requirement describes the finish and coating for the switchgear, which is part of the construction and finish of the CROWN-ARMV metal-clad MV switchgear.
The requirement specifies nameplates for devices and panels, which are typically included in the scope of supply for the CROWN-ARMV switchgear.
The requirement refers to general workmanship, which is a quality standard and not specific to a product. This is addressed by the bid manager.
The requirement refers to compliance with contract documents, which is a legal or administrative matter and not specific to a product. This is addressed by the bid manager.
